questions.q: Why does Receipt Accounting recognize an accrual at the time of receipt rather than waiting for the supplier's invoice?
options: Because invoices are never required in Oracle Fusion Cloud
Because receipts and invoices are always created on the same day
Because a company owes money for goods it has received whether or not the invoice has arrived yet, and waiting would understate liabilities at period end
Because Receipt Accounting only applies to canceled purchase orders
questions.explain: Recognizing the liability at receipt avoids understating what the company owes if the invoice has not yet arrived by period end.

questions.q: Which item type is always accrued on receipt, with no option to defer to period end?
options: Expense items only
Items with a match approval level of 2-way
Service items only
Inventory (asset) items
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion requires inventory items to use perpetual (on-receipt) accrual - there is no option to defer it to period end for inventory items.

questions.q: How is LTV's PB-4400 bearing, an expense item, configured for accrual in this course's transaction?
options: The Accrue Expense Items option is set to receipt, so it behaves like perpetual accrual even though it is an expense item
It never accrues at all
It can only accrue at calendar year-end
It accrues only if the invoice is more than 90 days late
questions.explain: LTV configures the bearing's accrual to occur on receipt rather than waiting for period end, even though it is categorized as an expense item.

questions.q: What does the accrual journal created when Priya's receipt is accepted record?
options: A debit to accounts payable and a credit to cash
A debit to the maintenance expense account and a credit to an uninvoiced receipts accrual liability account
A debit to the supplier's bank account
No journal is created until the invoice is received
questions.explain: The receipt accrual debits the charge account (maintenance expense here) and credits an uninvoiced receipts accrual account representing the liability.

questions.q: What happens to the uninvoiced receipts accrual account once Chen matches and accounts Meridian's invoice?
options: The invoice accounting debits this same accrual account and credits accounts payable, clearing the accrual
It is permanently ignored and never touched again
It doubles in value to reflect both the receipt and the invoice
It converts directly into cash paid to the supplier
questions.explain: The invoice's accounting clears the accrual by debiting it and crediting accounts payable, replacing the generic accrual with a liability to a specific supplier invoice.
